rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE PROPER INSTALLATION AND MAINTENANCE OF OVERHEAD ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION, COMMUNICATION LINES, AND STRUCTURES BY ALL ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION, CABLE, AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANIES FOR PURPOSES OF PUBLIC SAFETY AND GOOD HOUSEKEEPING
rows.title_short: Safe Overhead Electric Distribution, Cable, And Communications Lines Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to mandate all electric, cable, and telecommunications companies to conduct periodic inspections of their respective utility line installations to ensure strict compliance with the standards and regulations provided under the Philippine Electrical Code.
Directs all cities and municipalities through their respective city or municipal engineers of the DPWH in the case of national roads, to ensure that every utility company, within their territorial jurisdiction, complies with the provision of this Act.
Creates a Monitoring and Service Team to perform the immediate and necessary clean-up operation and maintenance of overhead electric distribution lines, cables, utility poles, equipment, and accessories in compliance with this Act.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-08-13, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-08-14 and received by the Senate on 2024-08-14

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING OCTOBER OF EVERY YEAR AS THE NATIONAL ESPORTS MONTH
rows.abstract:
Defines Esports as a form of organized multiplayer competition using video games, primarily between competitive gamers that includes the ability to perform in front of an audience, whether through an online platform, broadcasted on television, or at an in-person event.
Mandates the Department of Education (DepEd), Commission on Higher Education (CHED), and the National Academy of Sports (NAS) to promote the commemoration of the esports month in schools nationwide, both public and private.

rows.abstract:
Seeks to impose the same tax rates on non-conventional vehicles as those imposed for light cars. 
Classifies symmetrically arranged three-wheel vehicles, light quadricycle, and heavy quadricycle as non-conventional vehicles.
Imposes the motor vehicle road user´s tax (MVRUT) in lieu of the motor vehicle user´s charge (MVUC) on non-conventional vehicles.
